lines.t: The Lord Comes Night
Make the way straight
Make it straight for His return
The earth trembles, the King is coming
Thus says the Lord to the peoples of the earth
In my right hand, the power to birth
In my left hand, judgment and flame
I am He, the Ancient of Days
The Great I Am, the God of Abraham
And Jacob, whose name is Israel None can shake him
I sent my only begotten, the Word became flesh Yahushua, Emmanuel, righteousness and breath
He came once in mercy, he comes again in power Every knee will bow, every nation will cower
The Holy One returns, the trumpet sounds The Lord of hosts is heaven bound
Make the way straight, make the way straight Prepare His path, don't wait
Yahushua HaMashiach, the Lion will roar Call His name be restored
The Lord comes night, make the way straight Ahead came John, the voice in the wild
Crying, I repent, the spirit compiled
Trumpet in hand, water and word
Baptized the broken, spoke what he heard
Now war 44,000, rising the land
Firing their voices, trumpet in hand
Spirit of Elijah, thundering the breath
Preparing the way, defying death
Witnesses walking with tongues aflame
Bearing his name, now seeking fame
Judgments fall, foundations quake
The pride of man, the Lord shall break
Cities fall, towers bend
Desolation sweeps, yet there's hope in the end
Call upon Yeshua, call and be saved
The Lamb who conquered the grave
Yet the sanctuary in the storm A way of escape has been formed
He is the Christ Yahushua by name Call upon Him, be free from shame
Make the way straight
And let us back away
The lion will roar
Call his name, be restored
The Lord comes night
Make the way straight
And let us back away
Trumpets sound, hearts ignite
Yahushua reigns forever in light
Call upon Him
In truth
And you shall surely be delivered
Says the Lord
Make a way straight, call me, call me, make a way straight.
